data.name: Primary Efficacy Objective
data.text: To demonstrate that 3 mg LY900018 is non-inferior to 1 mg IMG for the proportion of patients achieving treatment success from insulin-induced hypoglycemia using a non-inferiority margin of 10%

data.name: Secondary Safety and Tolerability Objective
data.text: To compare the safety and tolerability of 3 mg LY900018 with 1 mg IMG

data.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Objective
data.text: To characterize the PK profile of 3 mg LY900018 compared to 1 mg IMG

data.name: Secondary Pharmacodynamic Objective
data.text: To characterize the PD profile of 3 mg LY900018 compared to 1 mg IMG

data.name: Primary Efficacy Endpoint - Treatment Success
data.text: The proportion of patients achieving treatment success defined as either an increase in PG to >70 mg/dL or an increase of >20 mg/dL from nadir within 30 minutes after administration of glucagon. The nadir is defined as the minimum PG value at the time of or within 10 minutes following glucagon administration.

data.name: Secondary Safety and Tolerability Endpoint
data.text: SAE, TEAEs (including gastrointestinal, nasal, and non-nasal AEs), vital signs

data.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Endpoint
data.text: PK parameters include AUC, Cmax, Tmax

data.name: Secondary Pharmacodynamic Endpoint
data.text: PD parameters include BGmax and Tmax

data.name: Primary Efficacy Estimand - Treatment Success Non-Inferiority
data.populationSummary: Japanese patients with type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) or type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) experiencing insulin-induced hypoglycemia who meet eligibility criteria (Per-Protocol Completers Population (at least 66 patients completing both periods with evaluable primary outcome)) Summary measure: Difference in proportions (percentage of patients achieving treatment success: IMG minus LY900018) with a 2-sided 95% confidence interval based on the 1-sample mean of paired differences; non-inferiority declared if upper limit of 95% CI is less than the non-inferiority margin of 10%.

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation before completion of both periods
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient discontinues from the study before completing both treatment periods with evaluable primary outcome for any reason (e.g., withdrawal of consent, adverse event, protocol deviation)

intercurrentEvents.name: Receipt of additional treatments to increase plasma glucose
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient receives additional treatments to increase plasma glucose within 30 minutes after glucagon administration, which is incorporated into the definition of treatment failure (i.e., treatment success requires no additional glucose-raising interventions)

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to achieve insulin-induced hypoglycemia nadir
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient does not achieve the required plasma glucose nadir during the insulin-induced hypoglycemia procedure, resulting in non-evaluable primary outcome data

intercurrentEvents.name: Device or administration failure
intercurrentEvents.text: Failure of nasal glucagon device or inability to administer the assigned study treatment as per protocol (e.g., nasal device malfunction, inability to complete IM injection)

data.treatment: 3 mg LY900018 (nasal glucagon) administered intranasally by study site personnel versus 1 mg intramuscular glucagon (IMG; GlucaGen, Novo Nordisk A/S) administered by IM injection by study site personnel in a 2-treatment, 2-period crossover design
data.analysisPopulation: Per-Protocol Completers Population (at least 66 patients completing both periods with evaluable primary outcome)
data.variableOfInterest: The proportion of patients achieving treatment success defined as either an increase in plasma glucose (PG) to ≥70 mg/dL or an increase of ≥20 mg/dL from PG nadir within 30 minutes after administration of glucagon, without receiving additional treatments to increase PG
data.summaryMeasure: Difference in proportions (percentage of patients achieving treatment success: IMG minus LY900018) with a 2-sided 95% confidence interval based on the 1-sample mean of paired differences; non-inferiority declared if upper limit of 95% CI is less than the non-inferiority margin of 10%

data.name: Secondary Safety and Tolerability Estimand
data.populationSummary: Japanese patients with T1DM or T2DM who received at least one dose of study treatment (LY900018 or IMG) (Safety Population (all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment)) Summary measure: Frequency and percentage of patients experiencing SAEs and TEAEs by system organ class and preferred term; descriptive statistics for vital signs.

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation due to adverse event
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient discontinues study participation due to an adverse event prior to completion of the follow-up visit

intercurrentEvents.name: Receipt of concomitant medications affecting safety assessments
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient receives concomitant medications that may confound the interpretation of adverse events or vital sign measurements

data.treatment: 3 mg LY900018 (nasal glucagon) administered intranasally versus 1 mg intramuscular glucagon (IMG; GlucaGen, Novo Nordisk A/S) administered by IM injection
data.analysisPopulation: Safety Population (all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment)
data.variableOfInterest: Incidence and nature of serious adverse events (SAEs), treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) including gastrointestinal, nasal, and non-nasal adverse events, and changes in vital signs following single-dose administration
data.summaryMeasure: Frequency and percentage of patients experiencing SAEs and TEAEs by system organ class and preferred term; descriptive statistics for vital signs

data.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Estimand
data.populationSummary: Japanese patients with T1DM or T2DM who received at least one dose of study treatment and have evaluable PK samples (PK Analysis Population (all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment with evaluable pharmacokinetic data)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics (mean, standard deviation, coefficient of variation, geometric mean) for AUC and Cmax; median and range for Tmax; geometric mean ratios with 90% confidence intervals for AUC and Cmax comparisons between treatments.

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing or non-evaluable PK samples
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient has missing or non-evaluable pharmacokinetic blood samples due to sampling errors, hemolysis, or other technical issues resulting in incomplete PK profiles

intercurrentEvents.name: Vomiting shortly after nasal glucagon administration
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient vomits shortly after nasal glucagon administration potentially affecting systemic absorption and PK profile

data.treatment: 3 mg LY900018 (nasal glucagon) administered intranasally versus 1 mg intramuscular glucagon (IMG; GlucaGen, Novo Nordisk A/S) administered by IM injection
data.analysisPopulation: PK Analysis Population (all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment with evaluable pharmacokinetic data)
data.variableOfInterest: Pharmacokinetic parameters including area under the concentration-time curve (AUC), maximum observed plasma concentration (Cmax), and time to maximum concentration (Tmax) following single-dose administration
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive statistics (mean, standard deviation, coefficient of variation, geometric mean) for AUC and Cmax; median and range for Tmax; geometric mean ratios with 90% confidence intervals for AUC and Cmax comparisons between treatments

data.name: Secondary Pharmacodynamic Estimand
data.populationSummary: Japanese patients with T1DM or T2DM who received at least one dose of study treatment and have evaluable PD measurements (PD Analysis Population (all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment with evaluable pharmacodynamic data)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics (mean, standard deviation, geometric mean) for BGmax; median and range for Tmax; comparison of PD parameters between treatment groups using geometric mean ratios with 90% confidence intervals where appropriate.

intercurrentEvents.name: Receipt of additional glucose-raising treatments
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient receives additional treatments to increase plasma glucose (e.g., intravenous dextrose) during the 30-minute assessment window, confounding the pharmacodynamic response attributable to study treatment

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing or non-evaluable plasma glucose measurements
intercurrentEvents.text: Patient has missing or non-evaluable plasma glucose measurements during the post-dose assessment period due to technical or procedural issues

data.treatment: 3 mg LY900018 (nasal glucagon) administered intranasally versus 1 mg intramuscular glucagon (IMG; GlucaGen, Novo Nordisk A/S) administered by IM injection
data.analysisPopulation: PD Analysis Population (all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment with evaluable pharmacodynamic data)
data.variableOfInterest: Pharmacodynamic parameters including maximum plasma glucose concentration (BGmax) and time to maximum plasma glucose concentration (Tmax) following single-dose glucagon administration during controlled insulin-induced hypoglycemia
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive statistics (mean, standard deviation, geometric mean) for BGmax; median and range for Tmax; comparison of PD parameters between treatment groups using geometric mean ratios with 90% confidence intervals where appropriate
